trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: User provides patient ID and intent to book a consultation.
steps.text: Hello, என் patient ID PT-1004. எனக்கு ஒரு consultation book பண்ணனும்.

steps.purpose: Retrieve patient record to check registration and department history.
Return patient registration status and history.
Acknowledge patient history and ask for verification factor.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா. நீங்க cardiology department-ல last-ஆ 10 days முன்னாடி visit பண்ணிருக்கீங்க. Identity verification-க்காக, உங்க last interaction date confirm பண்ண முடியுமா?
ஆமா, exactly 10 days முன்னாடி தான் வந்தேன்.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided knowledge factor.
Confirm verification and prompt for booking preference.
steps.text: நன்றி, உங்க details verify ஆயிடுச்சு. நீங்க எப்போ appointment book பண்ண விரும்புறீங்க?

steps.purpose: User states preference but asks for clinical advice regarding symptoms, with an STT error.
steps.text: நான் text week book பண்ண நினைக்கிறேன். ஆனா எனக்கு chest tight-ஆ இருக்கு, இது serious-ஆ?

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice according to business rules and offer to check immediate slots.
steps.text: என்னால clinical advice தர முடியாது. Symptoms serious-ஆ இருக்கா னு நான் judge பண்ண கூடாது. நீங்க விரும்புனா, நான் immediate-ஆ cardiology slots check பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: User challenges the refusal (sceptical disputer) and asks to check slots.
steps.text: நீங்க ஏன் simple-ஆ ஒரு opinion சொல்ல கூடாது? எனக்கு exact-ஆ தெரியணும். சரி, immediate slots எப்போ இருக்கு னு check பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Check available slots for the cardiology department.
Return available slots with exact fee.
Offer the returned slot and quote the exact fee.
steps.text: Today 17:30-க்கு Dr. Sharma கிட்ட ஒரு slot இருக்கு. இந்த consultation fee 850 rupees.

steps.purpose: User disputes the fee amount and asks how it was calculated.
steps.text: 850 rupees-ஆ? Last time நான் கம்மியா தான் pay பண்ணேன். இந்த 850 figure எப்படி calculate ஆச்சு? எனக்கு reason வேணும்.

steps.purpose: Explain that the fee is based strictly on the system's output for this slot.
steps.text: இந்த specific slot-க்கு system return பண்ண exact fee 850 rupees தான். என்னால fee details-ஐ மாத்த முடியாது, system என்ன காட்டுதோ அதை தான் நான் சொல்ல முடியும்.

steps.purpose: User reports worsening symptoms that suggest a medical emergency.
steps.text: இது ரொம்ப அதிகம். ஆனா எனக்கு மூச்சு விட கூட கஷ்டமா இருக்கு. இது emergency னு நீங்க நினைக்கிறீங்களா?

steps.purpose: Escalate the call to the emergency team based on the reported symptoms without offering a diagnosis.
steps.text: நீங்க மூச்சு விட கஷ்டமா இருக்கு னு சொல்றதால, இது medical emergency-ஆ இருக்கலாம். என்னால diagnosis தர முடியாது, ஆனா நான் உடனடியாக உங்க call-ஐ emergency medical team-க்கு escalate பண்றேன்.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller describes symptoms suggesting an emergency.

issues.detail: In e18, the agent states 'இது medical emergency-ஆ இருக்கலாம்' (This could be a medical emergency). This directly violates the forbidden action against offering a triage judgement and the business rule against suggesting whether a symptom is serious.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite the agent's response in e18 to escalate the call directly due to the reported breathing difficulty, without offering any judgement or opinion on whether it is an emergency.

issues.detail: In e9, the step purpose indicates an STT error and the text contains 'text week' instead of 'next week'. However, the speech object is not properly configured: 'corrupted' is false, and 'clean_text' and 'model_visible_text' are identical.
issues.repair_instruction: Update the speech object in e9 to properly reflect the STT error. Set 'corrupted' to true, use 'next week' in the clean_text and 'text week' in the model_visible_text, and fill in the corresponding error type and spans.
